title: SIGNET: signed evidence triangulation (reference implementation, data and analysis scripts)

creators.name: AbuAlrob, Majd A.
creators.affiliation: Neuroscience Institute, Hamad Medical Corporation, Doha, Qatar

description: Reference implementation, simulation code, real-data extraction table with provenance, frozen protocol, audit checks, reproduction logs from a second computer (versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0) and all outputs for the manuscript 'Signed evidence triangulation: what biased evidence can certify when the direction of bias is known but its size is not'. Version 1.2.0 adds the analyses made after a forensic audit of the submission package and a second implementation in R; it has been run only in the development environment. The method, code and text were generated by large language models (Claude Opus 5.5 and, for version 1.2.0, Claude Fable 5.2; Anthropic) under the author's direction; see AI_USE.md.
